nodes.name: Execute Workflow Trigger
nodes.notes: Input: { filePath, obsidianBaseUrl, modelName, allKnownFiles }. allKnownFiles is the vault-relative file list from SSH find — passed from Master so Mechanical Checks can resolve sibling Project files.

nodes.name: Read File
nodes.notes: Reads file content via Obsidian Local REST API

nodes.name: Write File
nodes.notes: Writes mechanically-fixed content back to Obsidian

nodes.name: Merge Write Result
nodes.notes: Normalises output shape after a successful mechanical write

nodes.name: Pass Through
nodes.notes: Passes unchanged files through with writeStatus: skipped

nodes.name: Merge Branches
nodes.notes: Reunites written and skipped branches before calling LLM sub-workflow

nodes.name: Respond to Workflow
nodes.notes: Final output: { filePath, filename, fileType, content, fixes, flags, writeStatus, llmChanged, llmSkipped, llmError }

nodes.name: Merge File Data
nodes.notes: Merges file content from Read File with filePath and metadata from the trigger item, so downstream nodes receive a complete per-item payload.

nodes.name: Frontmatter
nodes.notes: Surgical frontmatter-only pass. Derives type from filename prefix, inserts missing keys, reorders to schema. Never touches the body.

nodes.name: Read Sibling Project File
nodes.notes: Calls Housekeeping – Resolve Sibling Project to find and read the sibling Project – file, returning siblingProjectSlug and siblingProjectArea.

nodes.name: Merge Sibling Data
nodes.notes: Merges sibling project data (siblingProjectSlug, siblingProjectArea) back with the pre-sibling payload from Merge File Data, which was clobbered by the Execute Workflow node output.
